content.text:
I copied `inbox/2025-12.csv` into `data/` and committed it as `1e139c2` with the message `2025-12: add rows`.

`scripts/check.sh` printed OK before the commit. It checks that every row has the same number of fields as the header, and it picked up the new file because `check.conf` sets the year to 2025.

The file has the category spelling "wholsale" in one row. The 2025-10 and 2025-11 files also have one "wholsale" each, so I left it as it was. If that's a typo, it may be worth fixing across all three files.

I only counted "wholsale" and didn't compare the full category lists, so other inconsistencies could exist. The check script doesn't test category values anyway.
